subject: Security intake: incident notification SLAs, BCP evidence & SOC 2 snapshot (post-demo)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@luneanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: security intake / IR & BCP evidence next steps

Hi Alyssa / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and three asks so we can move the security intake forward: 

1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether Lune has a SOC 2 Type II in progress or planned? If you have a one-page SOC snapshot (scope, auditor, expected report date), please share.

2) Incident response & breach notification: we reviewed notification windows during the call (internal SLA vs. customer notification). Please confirm your internal IR SLA for incident detection and customer notification (e.g., 72 hours, 7 days) and who owns external comms. We need an example incident-notification timeline (redacted) if available.

3) BCP/DR evidence: we request the following artifacts to complete our compliance review — DR runbook excerpt, backup retention policy, and a high-level BCP/availability diagram. If anything is sensitive, you can upload to the secure folder (link below) or share via the intake mailbox.

I attached a short security-intake form that lists the above items. Proposed next steps: you upload the SOC snapshot + IR timeline by EOD Thu (2026-06-24) and we’ll schedule a 30-minute follow-up next week to review gaps.

Secure upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-lune-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4872

If you prefer to run through answers in a live call, we can carve out 30 minutes on Wed.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood-security-intake-form.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@luneanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security intake / IR & BCP evidence next steps

Jordan —

Appreciate the recap and clear asks. Quick answers here and we’ll upload documents this week: 

- SOC 2: In progress (Type I completed 2025-11). We’ve engaged ClearView Audit; Type II expected Q4 2026. I’ll attach a one-page SOC snapshot.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Lune processes pseudonymized datasets for analytics; we are currently assessing full HIPAA scope (no PHI in production pipelines today). We will flag any HIPAA-relevant artifacts.
- IR & notifications: Our internal policy is 48 hours to identify/characterize and 72 hours for customer notification where customer data is implicated. I’ve attached a redacted timeline from a tabletop exercise.
- BCP/DR: We’ll provide the DR runbook excerpt and backup retention clause.

We’ll upload to the Drive folder by EOD Thu. If you need something sooner, Raj can share directly.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform Security, Lune Analytics
alyssa@luneanalytics.com | +1 650-555-0987

Looping in Marissa for IR evidence intake and to confirm what we can share back to the customer as a Redwood request template. Quick notes: 

- Ask Alyssa for a one-page SOC snapshot (fields: scope, auditor, coverage dates, expected Type II date). That avoids full report sharing.
- For IR timelines: request a redacted timeline + tabletop report; if they can’t share tabletop, the redacted timeline + owner contacts suffice.
- BCP artifacts: runbook excerpt (2-3 pages), backup retention excerpt, and a short availability/DR diagram (PNG).

Marissa — can you prepare a small intake email template and the secure upload instructions (S3 presign / Drive link + retention note)? Also, confirm if we need an NDA before they upload runbooks.

Ben Carter
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: security intake / IR & BCP evidence next steps

Thanks Alyssa — this is great. Confirming next steps and a few clarifications: 

1) Upload target: EOD Thu (2026-06-24) to the Drive folder above. If you prefer S3 presigned upload, Marissa will send presigned link by EOD today.
2) SOC snapshot: a 1-pager is perfect. We’ll use that to scope our checklist; full report isn’t required at this stage.
3) IR timeline: redacted tabletop exercise timeline is acceptable. If the tabletop includes any sensitive customer names, redact them.
4) HIPAA: sounds good to flag any artifacts that touch PHI; we’ll mark those as restricted.

We’ll confirm once we receive artifacts and schedule a 30-minute follow-up for next Tue (2026-06-29) to review questions. If Lune would like a quick call before uploading, Raj, Alyssa — pick a time and we’ll join.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Jordan Blake
